heroHeadline: Bad Bunny Opens "Cerramos en Casa" Homecoming Finale at Hiram Bithorn Stadium
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny played the first of two sold-out "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" shows at Estadio Hiram Bithorn on August 22, closing the record-breaking, $467.5 million-grossing Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour in the city where it launched. Roughly 30,000 fans packed the newly renovated ($39.6M) stadium, backed by a citywide transportation and security plan for 60,000+ attendees across both nights. A second closing show follows August 23.
